about: The authoritative device-lab journey list (fm-journey-registry-5cpg). lab.py runs only implemented journeys named here and fails a summary when a run exceeds its cell budget. Budgets are wall-clock seconds per journey, measured once with `lab.py run --repeat 3` per cell and frozen at 1.5 x the slowest run, rounded up to 5 s. Changing a budget or adding a journey is a reviewed diff to this file with a bead naming the flow; a cell without a measured budget reports its duration as unbudgeted.

cold-face.flow: First face on a fresh profile: arrival, consented model download, CPU/WebGPU admission and one generated face (PLAN.md#device-lab-deploy-gates-and-ci-policy-operator-24-october-2026).

warm-face.flow: A face with the models already cached: generate on the admitted route, no download (PLAN.md#device-lab-deploy-gates-and-ci-policy-operator-24-october-2026).

morph.flow: Create Morph from two generated faces through to a playable MP4 (PLAN.md#ui-flow-matrix-and-open-journey-contracts).

operated.flow: Operated-input contract on the defect-1 regression fixture: real taps/clicks press visible controls and refuse covered, clipped and off-screen ones (fm-48bj).

photo-face.flow: Choose a photo from a face card, confirm the crop, encode with e4e and add the face.

export.flow: Save and share a face image and the morph MP4 with recovery metadata (fm-y2jb, fm-qh1s).

blend.flow: Blend view (fm-2kse): from two generated faces, More options, Blend faces, Blend: one blend synthesis shown as the result, then Back. No frozen budget yet.
